reply.rationale: No defensible compositional paradigm is supported by this codebook. The two-letter symbols do not show a stable substitution frame with recurring forms making consistent contributions across multiple entries. Apparent shared letters fail the required evidence test: for example, D occurs in DS, DC, DM with drifting/dim meanings but no stable common contribution; W occurs in WB, BW, RW with wobble/white/whine-related material but not a single role; C occurs in HC, DC, CK with center/corners/clicking-related content but no compositional consistency. The standalone symbols K and face-pair also do not participate in any multi-entry substitution pattern. Because no split yields a meaning-consistent paradigm with predictable whole meanings, the safest analysis is a flat lexicon.
